## About

Montreux Group LLC is a Registered Investment Advisor (FINRA CRD 338982) based at 42 W. 38th St., Suite 800, New York, NY 10018.

Contact: f.hasan@montreuxwealth.com

## Services

- Investment management (equities, fixed income, alternatives, private markets)
- Financial planning (retirement, estate, succession, insurance)
- Accounting and tax (preparation, K-1, proactive planning)
- Cash Balance Plans for high-income business owners
